entries.title: Reinforcement learning in robotics
entries.key_innovation: Surveys robot reinforcement learning, analyzing how algorithms, representations, and prior knowledge address complexity in behavior generation.

entries.title: Mastering the game of go without human knowledge
entries.key_innovation: Learns superhuman Go solely through self-play reinforcement learning, using a neural network with Monte Carlo tree search and no human data.

entries.title: Swinging up and stabilization of a real inverted pendulum
entries.key_innovation: Combines a fuzzy swinging algorithm, an adaptive state controller, and a switching mechanism to swing up, balance, and position a real inverted pendulum under constraints.

entries.title: The oracle problem in software testing
entries.key_innovation: Surveys test oracle automation approaches such as modeling, specifications, contracts, metamorphic testing, and human informal oracles for distinguishing correct behavior.

entries.title: Lyapunov stability theory
entries.key_innovation: Establishes Lyapunov methods for analyzing stability of dynamical systems without explicitly solving their differential equations.

entries.title: Stable-baselines3
entries.key_innovation: Provides a PyTorch-based library of reliable, benchmarked implementations of deep reinforcement learning algorithms.

entries.title: Github stable baselines3 repository
entries.key_innovation: Maintains an open-source GitHub repository for Stable-Baselines3, providing versioned, documented reinforcement learning implementations and examples.

entries.title: Asynchronous methods for deep reinforcement learning
entries.key_innovation: Uses asynchronous parallel actor-learners to train deep neural network policies stably without experience replay.

entries.title: Addressing function approximation error in actor-critic methods
entries.key_innovation: Reduces overestimation bias in actor-critic methods via clipped double Q-learning, delayed policy updates, and target policy smoothing.

entries.title: Q-learning
entries.key_innovation: Introduces off-policy, model-free Q-learning that learns optimal action values through temporal-difference updates.

entries.title: Faults in deep reinforcement learning programs
entries.key_innovation: Characterizes common faults and failure patterns in deep reinforcement learning programs, likely providing a taxonomy and implications for testing.

entries.title: Stable baselines
entries.key_innovation: Provides a TensorFlow-based library of reliable reinforcement learning algorithm implementations with standardized interfaces and benchmarking.

entries.title: A search-based testing approach for deep reinforcement learning agents
entries.key_innovation: Proposes search-based testing that generates realistic test scenarios for deep reinforcement learning agents to detect safety-critical failures beyond adversarial perturbations.

entries.title: Gymnasium
entries.key_innovation: Provides a standard API and collection of environments for reinforcement learning, maintaining compatibility as the Gymnasium interface.

entries.title: Receiver operating characteristic curve in diagnostic test assessment
entries.key_innovation: Uses ROC curves to evaluate and compare diagnostic test accuracy across decision thresholds.

entries.title: Metamorphic testing
entries.key_innovation: Reviews metamorphic testing approaches for test case generation and result verification using metamorphic relations across multiple inputs and outputs.

entries.title: Testing and validating machine learning classifiers by metamorphic testing
entries.key_innovation: Applies metamorphic testing to machine learning classifiers, using input transformations and expected output relations to detect faults without a test oracle.

entries.title: Search-based testing of reinforcement learning
entries.key_innovation: Uses search to find boundary states near reference traces and fuzz testing traces to create safety and performance test-suites for deep RL agents.

entries.title: Model-based test oracle generation for automated unit testing of agent systems
entries.key_innovation: Introduces a model-based oracle generation method for unit testing belief-desire-intention agents, using a fault model derived from core BDI features to automatically decide correctness.

entries.title: Formal specification and testing for reinforcement learning
entries.key_innovation: Introduces a formal specification and property-based test harness for temporal difference reinforcement learning algorithms, rooted in functional programming and backup-diagram semantics.

entries.title: Quickcheck
entries.key_innovation: Presents QuickCheck, a property-based random testing tool for Haskell that checks executable properties and supports custom test data generators.

entries.title: A composable specification language for reinforcement learning tasks
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a composable specification language for reinforcement learning tasks, enabling modular and reusable task definitions.

entries.title: Deepmutation++
entries.key_innovation: Introduces DeepMutation++, a mutation testing tool for deep neural networks that supports feed-forward and recurrent networks and identifies vulnerable input segments via static and runtime analysis.

entries.title: What are we really testing in mutation testing for machine learning? a critical reflection
entries.key_innovation: Argues that deep learning mutation testing often deviates from classical mutation testing because ML model development resembles test-driven development, reframing its interpretation.

entries.title: Coverage-guided fuzzing for deep reinforcement learning systems
entries.key_innovation: Introduces a coverage-guided fuzzing framework for deep reinforcement learning systems that generates diverse failure-driving test cases.

entries.title: Quantifying the carbon emissions of machine learning
entries.key_innovation: Presents a method for quantifying the carbon emissions of machine learning workloads, enabling assessment of their environmental impact.

entries.title: Linear Matrix Inequalities in System and Control Theory
entries.key_innovation: Develops linear matrix inequalities as a unified framework for analyzing and designing control systems.
